name: minitta-erp
description: ERP de Minitta Joyería: base de datos v2, API (NestJS) e interfaz (React)

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @minitta/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c gray,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @minitta/shared" "npm run dev -w @minitta/api" "npm run dev -w @minitta/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @minitta/shared && npm run build -w @minitta/api && npm run build -w @minitta/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @minitta/shared && npm run typecheck -w @minitta/api && npm run typecheck -w @minitta/web
